patch_description: The main inefficiencies: (1) `grad_ascent` contains dead placeholder code (an empty analytic loop, a dead `np.add.at`) and runs a full numeric gradient through `score` with a C(13,3)=286-triangle evaluation per coordinate — very slow with negligible benefit. We replace it with a lean, corrected version that computes the finite-difference gradient only on a subset of promising directions using the true smooth score, with adaptive step. (2) Basin hopping is expanded per the recommendation: 8 perturbations across amplitudes drawn from a deterministic schedule, applied to the top-3 elites (not just the best), each followed by grad_ascent + hill_climb. This is the proven-cheap extension suggested and reuses existing machinery. Time budget should remain similar because grad_ascent iterations are reduced and dead code removed.
